Name: Fish's Flowers (Hyacinth and Pansy)
Author: FishWaffle64
Description:
Via Json Assets, add two flowers to your game! These are Pansies and Hyacinth, my two personal favorite flowers. Just unpack the folder into Mods and it'll work in tandem with JA and boom! You can buy the seeds at Pierre's :)

Pansies grow in Spring, Summer, and Fall. Hyacinth is only in Spring.
